plan.sampling: Uniform rows without replacement from category-unpurged training pool; no target-based selection; preserve original input order
plan.test: Exactly the same held-out category observations in both arms
plan.tuning: Original nested, study-purged inner rule and candidates; fixed original seed
plan.aggregation: Mean absolute loss per row across 20 repetitions, then equal original-study mean; not ensemble predictions
plan.interval: 2000 paired original-study resamples of repetition-averaged fixed losses; conditional, unadjusted; does not include refitting uncertainty
plan.limits: Matches observation count only; study count, feature support and composition differ; not a pure leakage estimate
